```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(tidyverse)
library(rawDiag)
```

Investigate ion inject times using `rawDiag` package.


```{r}
raw_file_names <- dir("E:/TEMPDATA/sprg/raw", full.names = TRUE)[grep(".raw", list.files("E:/TEMPDATA/sprg/raw"))]
RAW <- lapply(raw_file_names, read.raw)
data <- bind_rows(RAW)

# boxplot of fill times as a function of RT
data %>% 
  filter(MSOrder == "Ms2") %>% 
  ggplot() +
  geom_boxplot(aes(x = cut_number(StartTime, n = 25), y = IonInjectionTimems, color = filename), outlier.shape = NA) +
  theme_light() +
  facet_wrap(~ filename) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank()) +
  labs(x = "Retention Time (min)",
       y = "Ion Injection Time (ms)")

```

```{r}
temp <- data %>%
  filter(filename %in% c('20211105_CAHumanLiverDDADiluted_01.raw', 
            '20211105_CACowLiverDDA_01.raw', 
            '20211105_CAFishAQDDA_01.raw'))

#BasePeak/TIC&InjectionTime
temp %>%
  ggplot() +
  geom_line(aes(x=StartTime,y=BasePeakIntensity, color=filename), alpha=0.5) + #rawMS$TIC instead of BasePeakIntensity
  theme_light() +
  scale_colour_manual(name="species",
                        breaks=c('20211105_CAHumanLiverDDADiluted_01.raw', 
                                 '20211105_CACowLiverDDA_01.raw', 
                                 '20211105_CAFishAQDDA_01.raw'),
                        labels=c("Human (liver)", "Cow (liver)", "Fish (lake trout filet)"),
                        values=c('#cd853f', '#029386', '#0343DF')) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        legend.position = c(0.75, 0.75)) +
  labs(x = "Retention Time (min)",
       y = "Base Peak Intensity")
  #geom_jitter(aes(rawMS$StartTime,rawMS$IonInjectionTimems*5*10^6),size=0.1,col="red",alpha=0.2)+
  #scale_y_continuous(sec.axis=sec_axis(~./(5*10^6)))
ggsave("tic_overlay.png", width = 6, height = 4, units = "in")

```
